production_order_no.description: Join key — identity of the OperationsRequest. The OperationsResponse reports its actuals back via the same key (RESPONDS_TO).

sales_order_ref.description: The customer order this production order serves: the ERP key of that order (= CustomerOrder.order_no), the only link to the customer data. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/production-order.md, attributes › sales_order_ref › description.

article_ref.description: Article to be manufactured (article_no, join key to Article).

machine_ref.description: Planned executing machine / line (machine_no), reached via SegmentRequirement REQUIRES_EQUIPMENT Machine (machine_id).

department_ref.description: ERP department the order is routed to. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/production-order.md, attributes › department_ref › description.

qty_planned.description: Planned piece count (target). Counterpart to OperationsResponse.quantity_produced. Driver of the qty_shortfall rule.

planned_start_time.description: Planned START of the order's next non-terminal operation. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/production-order.md, attributes › planned_start_time › description.

planned_end_time.description: Planned completion date (target). Counterpart to actual_end_time. Driver of the late_delivery rule.

dispatch_sequence.description: 1-based position of this order in its machine's dispatch queue, inside the 24 h horizon. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/production-order.md, attributes › dispatch_sequence › description.

material_ready_at.description: Time from which material is available — material-ready constraint.

quantity.description: Ordered piece count (geplante_stueckzahl). Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/production-order.md, attributes › quantity › description.

status.description: Plan status of the OperationsRequest, as it reaches THIS profile through OUR source binding. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/production-order.md, attributes › status › description.

updated_at.description: Last change. Server-managed and volatile on every read (sim-v5 returns a fresh value per GET), so promotion:never — kept in the snapshot but excluded from the change-trigger and never published on its own.
